notes.title: 📢 Update Notice – Gallery Issue Resolved!
notes.content:
We’ve received reports from some players stating that the gallery remained locked even after completing the game.
Our team identified the issue and we’re happy to confirm that it has been fully resolved in the latest update.

✅ Players who finish the game will now have proper access to the gallery.
🔁 There’s no need to restart your save file — everything will update automatically.

Thanks for your patience and support. Enjoy the game!
